methodologyNotes: Specs sourced from official manufacturer product pages (synology.com, qnap.com, asustor.com, terra-master.com, ugreen.com, ui.com) and corroborated via independent review sites (storagereview.com), retailer listings (newegg.com, bhphotovideo.com), and product comparison pages. Synology's US product pages consistently redirect to their Download Center during this research session; Synology specs were obtained from their global product pages and confirmed via storagereview.com review articles. TerraMaster's site was rate-limited during the session; TerraMaster F4-424 Pro specs obtained via Newegg product listings. ASUSTOR specs obtained directly from asustor.com product pages. QNAP specs obtained from qnap.com product pages and Newegg listings. UGREEN NASync DXP4800 Plus specs from Newegg listings and ugreen.com. Ubiquiti UNAS Pro specs from storagereview.com review and ui.com store page. The DS224+ has no M.2 slots per Synology spec page. The DS923+ and DS925+ each have 2 M.2 NVMe slots per Synology spec pages. The DS1522+ and DS1525+ each have 2 M.2 NVMe slots. Prices are US MSRP or street price (lowest confirmed diskless configuration) as observed at retail listings accessed 2026-06-15. The DS224+ diskless base price could not be confirmed from a diskless-only Newegg listing; $299 is the widely cited MSRP per multiple review references. priceUsd=null used only where no US price could be confirmed from any source. A null beats any guess.

products.name: Synology DiskStation DS224+
products.priceNote: US MSRP diskless; widely cited at ~$300 at launch. Newegg shows only bundled-drive configs from $869; diskless available direct from Synology.
products.provenance: CPU Intel Celeron J4125 4-core 2.0–2.7 GHz, 2 GB DDR4 non-ECC (expandable to 6 GB), 2 bays (3.5" SATA or 2.5" SATA SSD), 2x 1GbE, no M.2 slots confirmed from synology.com/en-us/products/DS224+ spec page.
